def_en: 1) to be contentious, be rebellious, be refractory, be disobedient towards, be rebellious against
1b) (Hiphil) to show rebelliousness, show disobedience, disobey
kjv: bitter, change, be disobedient, disobey, grievously, provocation, provoke(-ing), (be) rebel (against, -lious).
expl: to be (causatively, make) bitter (or unpleasant); (figuratively) to rebel (or resist; causatively, to provoke)
